description: Get a deal/project's mini P&L: income, costs by category, and net margin, computed from bank transactions linked to it, plus invoice/bill/expense-claim commitment summaries. Use for "how is project X doing", "project profit", "mini P&L for a project", and for the final report when a project completes. Pass project_id if known, or project_name to resolve it by name.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

project_name.description: Project name to resolve if project_id is not known. Case-insensitive; errors with candidate names if ambiguous.

name: get_project_pnl
title: Get Project Pnl
